case_notes.note: Bonus on last payslip; claimant says not recurring.

deciding.undeclared_change: Payroll 2350 vs declared 1050 is large and unreported, but one_off_payment 1250 leaves about 1100, close to declared, and the source is a claimant upload.
deciding.next_step: Payroll 2350 exceeds nil_entitlement_earnings 2000, which supports suspension, while the one-off bonus supports simply recalculating the rate.
deciding.change_category: Excluding the one-off 1250, earnings match the declaration closely, so no lasting change; some doubt remains because the bonus is claimant-evidenced.
deciding.affected_scope: A single award with household_members 2, so it affects one claimant or two people.
